what: Token budget of draw.io generation. 'small' = reverse the arrows in the user's 3-box diagram; 'big' = author a 24-entity ER diagram. Point: reasoning and answer share ONE max_tokens budget, and on big diagrams reasoning takes about two thirds of it. Real draw.io XML tokenises at 2.73 chars/token (measured), so 14k chars of XML is only ~5.1k tokens — the budget goes on thinking, not on the diagram.
fence_defect: A 4th big-diagram run, made ad hoc before this batch, emitted correct HTML with NO ```html fence, which OWUI renders as nothing. This batch is 3/3 fenced, so the rate is roughly 1 in 4 and intermittent, not deterministic.
